## 2 Day Drone Technology Workshop

28 Sep 2026 - 29 Sep 2026 |Organized by:Department of Mechanical Engineering
Department of Mechanical Engineering presents2 Day Drone Technology WorkshopExplore the Sky. Engineer the Future.🚁 UPCOMING EVENT  |  28–29 SEPTEMBER 2026Event Details📅 Dates28 & 29 September 2026⏰ Time9:30 AM to 4:00 PM📍 VenueB-401 & B-404, MGIT Campus, Gandipet, Hyderabad🎤 Resource PersonMr. P. Srinivas ReddyEuphostraaa Systems LLP💳 Registration Fee₹ 600 per participant⏳ Last Date to Register28 September 2026🎓 CertificateParticipation certificate for all attendees📝 Register NowAbout the WorkshopDrones are reshaping how the world works, from precision agriculture and infrastructure inspection to logistics, mapping and disaster response. To give students a real head start in this fast-growing field, theDepartment of Mechanical Engineering, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Technology (MGIT), Hyderabad, is organising a2 Day Drone Technology Workshopon 28 and 29 September 2026.Led by industry trainerMr. P. Srinivas Reddy of Euphostraaa Systems LLP, this intensive hands-on workshop takes participants through the complete drone-building journey. Students will explore drone sensors and components, assemble a drone from real parts, calibrate and configure its flight systems, and finally take it to the sky in a live flight demonstration. Come curious, leave with the skills to build and fly.What You Will Learn🔧 Hands-on PracticeWork directly with real drone components and equipment.📡 Sensors & ComponentsUnderstand flight controllers, motors, sensors and how they work together.⚙️ Assembly & ConfigurationBuild a working drone and calibrate its flight systems step by step.🚁 Live Flight DemonstrationOperate the drone you configured in a guided flight session.🏭 Industry-oriented UAV KnowledgeLearn how UAVs are used across industries today.🎓 CertificationReceive a participation certificate on completion.Participant GuidelinesTheInaugural Session and Basic Training Sessionwill be held inB-401 at 9:00 AM.TheDrone Building and Assembly Workshopwill be conducted inB-404.Bring yourlaptop. Download all required files as instructed and come prepared so you do not fall behind.You may bring a small mat to sit comfortably during the drone building and assembly activities.Lunch break:12:30 PM to 1:00 PM only.Attendance iscompulsoryand will be forwarded to the respective class teachers.Be punctual, interact actively with the trainers and participate enthusiastically.💳 Payment DetailsAccount Name:MGIT Conferences Seminars and WorkshopAccount Number:438501000066IFSC Code:ICIC0004385Branch:CBIT Gandipet Branch📞 Contact for QueriesDr. Y.V.N.
